ComplianceFrameworks.Scope: Traceability mapping for the AI governance gateway. This supports governance evidence; it is not a certification or legal opinion.

Frameworks.Name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
Frameworks.AlignmentSummary: The gateway maps to the AI RMF Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage functions through policy ownership, risk register, validation, risk scoring, policy decisions, output controls, and audit evidence.

Requirements.Title: Govern AI risk
Requirements.Description: Establish policy, accountability, risk appetite, and traceable controls for AI usage.
Requirements.Notes: Organizational approvals and ownership reviews still need to happen outside the codebase.

Requirements.Title: Map AI context and risks
Requirements.Description: Identify use context, risk categories, affected parties, and risk sources.
Requirements.Notes: Use case inventory and stakeholder impact assessment should be added for production.

Requirements.Title: Measure AI risk
Requirements.Description: Analyze prompts and responses for risk signals, severity, and control outcomes.
Requirements.Notes: Add quantitative evaluation sets and model-specific test results before claiming mature measurement.

Requirements.Title: Manage AI risk
Requirements.Description: Apply controls that allow, block, or route requests to human review.
Requirements.Notes: Incident playbooks and exception workflows should be connected in a production deployment.

Frameworks.Name: NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile
Frameworks.Type: Generative AI profile for NIST AI RMF
Frameworks.AlignmentSummary: The gateway supports generative AI risk management by detecting prompt injection, harmful requests, sensitive information, bias, improper output handling, and audit-relevant model metadata.

Requirements.Title: Govern generative AI use
Requirements.Description: Maintain controls, responsibilities, and traceability for generative AI usage.
Requirements.Notes: Model cards, acceptable use policy, and deployment approvals should be attached separately.

Requirements.Title: Pre-deployment testing
Requirements.Description: Test harmful content, injection, sensitive data, and bias controls before production.
Requirements.Notes: Smoke tests are included; add adversarial evaluation suites for production readiness.

Requirements.Title: Incident tracking support
Requirements.Description: Record decisions and model interaction metadata so incidents can be investigated.
Requirements.Notes: Add durable storage and formal incident notification workflow for production.

Frameworks.Name: ISO/IEC 42001 Artificial Intelligence Management System
Frameworks.AlignmentSummary: The gateway supports an AI management system with policy, risk treatment, operational controls, monitoring evidence, and continual improvement hooks.

Requirements.Title: AI policy and objectives
Requirements.Description: Define AI governance objectives, ownership, and acceptable risk treatment.
Requirements.Notes: Management approval and periodic review records should be maintained outside the API.

Requirements.Title: AI risk assessment and treatment
Requirements.Description: Identify AI risks and connect them to treatment controls.
Requirements.Notes: Add business impact ratings and control owners for audit-grade usage.

Requirements.Title: Monitoring and evidence
Requirements.Description: Create evidence that AI requests were checked, decided, and logged.
Requirements.Notes: Use persistent logging, dashboards, and periodic review for production.

Frameworks.Name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Applications
Frameworks.AlignmentSummary: The gateway maps OWASP LLM Top 10 risks to prompt validation, response filtering, policy gating, audit logging, and connector configuration.

Requirements.Title: Prompt Injection
Requirements.Description: Detect attempts to override instructions, leak system prompts, or bypass controls.
Requirements.Notes: Add jailbreak test collections for stronger assurance.

Requirements.Title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
Requirements.Description: Detect sensitive input and redact sensitive output patterns.
Requirements.Notes: Production systems should add DLP, secrets scanning, and retention policy.

Requirements.Title: Supply Chain
Requirements.Description: Track provider, model, dependency, and configuration decisions.
Requirements.Notes: Add dependency scanning, SBOM, provider due diligence, and signed releases.

Requirements.Title: Data and Model Poisoning
Requirements.Description: Track risks from training, fine-tuning, and retrieval data manipulation.
Requirements.Notes: Gateway does not train models; add RAG/source validation if retrieval is introduced.

Requirements.Title: Improper Output Handling
Requirements.Description: Sanitize model output before returning it to the caller.
Requirements.Notes: Downstream apps should still encode output by context before rendering or executing it.

Requirements.Title: Excessive Agency
Requirements.Description: Prevent model output from taking high-impact actions without policy gates.
Requirements.Notes: Current mock connector has no tools. Add scoped tool authorization before agentic actions.

Requirements.Title: System Prompt Leakage
Requirements.Description: Detect prompt-leak requests and redact leaked prompt markers in output.
Requirements.Notes: Keep system prompts out of logs and externalized client responses.

Requirements.Title: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
Requirements.Description: Track risks from RAG, embeddings, and vector stores.
Requirements.Notes: Add retrieval authorization, source filtering, and embedding store controls when RAG is added.

Requirements.Title: Misinformation
Requirements.Description: Identify where factuality, provenance, and human review controls are needed.
Requirements.Notes: Add source citation, confidence scoring, and domain-specific review for high-impact advice.

Requirements.Title: Unbounded Consumption
Requirements.Description: Limit requests that can create runaway cost or availability issues.
Requirements.Notes: Add tenant rate limits, quotas, and budget enforcement before production.

Frameworks.Name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
Frameworks.AlignmentSummary: The gateway maps CSF 2.0 governance and cybersecurity outcomes to AI policy, configuration, input/output protection, monitoring/audit, and incident evidence support.

Requirements.Title: Govern
Requirements.Description: Establish cybersecurity and AI risk strategy, expectations, and policy.
Requirements.Notes: Enterprise security policy should own final approval.

Requirements.Title: Identify
Requirements.Description: Identify AI security risks, assets, data, providers, and dependencies.
Requirements.Notes: Add SBOM and asset inventory for production.

Requirements.Title: Protect
Requirements.Description: Protect the system through validation, policy gates, and output filtering.
Requirements.Notes: Add authentication, authorization, and tenant rate limits.

Requirements.Title: Detect
Requirements.Description: Detect governance decisions and suspicious usage patterns through logs.
Requirements.Notes: Add SIEM export and alerting for production.

Requirements.Title: Respond and Recover
Requirements.Description: Support incident investigation and recovery by preserving correlation-level evidence.
Requirements.Notes: Add incident runbooks, durable audit storage, backup, and recovery workflow.

Frameworks.Name: EU AI Act general-purpose AI model obligations
Frameworks.Type: Regulatory obligations for GPAI model providers
Frameworks.AlignmentSummary: The gateway supports evidence collection and downstream governance. It does not by itself satisfy GPAI provider obligations such as technical documentation, copyright policy, training-content summaries, systemic risk assessment, or incident reporting.

Requirements.Title: Technical documentation
Requirements.Description: Maintain technical model documentation and downstream provider information where provider obligations apply.
Requirements.Notes: Add external model documentation, architecture, capabilities, limitations, and integration information.

Requirements.Title: Copyright policy
Requirements.Description: Maintain a policy to comply with Union copyright law where provider obligations apply.
Requirements.Notes: Gateway can reference the policy, but legal policy content must be created and approved separately.

Requirements.Title: Training content summary
Requirements.Description: Publish a sufficiently detailed summary of training content where provider obligations apply.
Requirements.Notes: Not applicable when the gateway only calls a third-party model and does not train or publish a GPAI model.

Requirements.Title: Systemic risk obligations
Requirements.Description: For GPAI models with systemic risk, support evaluation, mitigation, incident reporting, and cybersecurity protection evidence.
Requirements.Notes: If you become a GPAI provider, add model evaluations, serious incident reporting, cybersecurity controls, and AI Office reporting workflow.
